# Gerillass

> A Sass toolkit of 53 mixins and 24 functions, built to be read by coding agents as well as by people. Every member is described in a machine-readable manifest whose examples and refusals are executed by the test suite, so the documentation cannot drift away from the code.

Gerillass is a pure Sass library. There is no build step and no runtime dependency: the `.scss` sources are the deliverable, and the package installs nothing else. It needs Dart Sass; LibSass and node-sass are not supported. This file describes Gerillass 3.0.0.

Load it with `@use "gerillass" as *;` under a bundler, or `@use "pkg:gerillass" as *;` with the Dart Sass package importer. It is also a Ruby gem, `gerillass`: Rails with dartsass-rails or dartsass-sprockets, and Jekyll, need no configuration, and plain Ruby passes `Gerillass.load_path` to sass-embedded.

Every mixin answers to two names, bare and prefixed: `@include circle(50px)` and `@include gls-circle(50px)` are the same mixin and produce identical CSS. The prefix exists to avoid collisions with other libraries. You can also namespace the whole library instead, with `@use "gerillass" as gls;` and `@include gls.circle(50px)`.

Mixins are kebab-case and always need `@include`. Functions are camelCase and never take it. That is the whole naming convention, and it is what tells the two apart at a call site.

Arguments are validated and refused with a message naming what is accepted, so a wrong call produces an error rather than a missing declaration. The exception is a value passed straight through to CSS, which is left alone so that `var()`, `calc()` and `clamp()` keep working.

## Mixins

- [adaptive($gutter: 30px)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/adaptive/): Centred container whose max-width steps up at every breakpoint.
- [after($content: null)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/after/): Styles the ::after pseudo-element.
- [all-buttons($pseudo: null)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/all-buttons/): Targets every button element at once, optionally in one pseudo-class state.
- [all-text-inputs($pseudo: null)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/all-text-inputs/): Targets every form control a browser draws as a text field, textarea included, optionally in one pseudo-class state.
- [antialias($value: null)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/antialias/): Draws text with greyscale antialiasing instead of subpixel, which makes it look thinner.
- [aspect-ratio($ratio: null, $fit: cover)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/aspect-ratio/): Holds an element to a ratio and adds what CSS aspect-ratio alone leaves out: object-fit so an image is cropped rather than stretched, and border: 0 so an iframe does not overflow its container by 4px.
- [background-image($image-url: null, $filter-color: null, $filter-direction: null)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/background-image/): Background image with an optional colour or gradient filter laid over it.
- [background-pattern($kind: dots, $params...)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/background-pattern/): Twenty background patterns drawn with gradients alone: seventeen that tile, from dots and stripes to houndstooth and harlequin, and glow, vignette and mesh, which light the whole box.
- [before($content: null)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/before/): Styles the ::before pseudo-element.
- [border-box($value: null)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/border-box/): Applies box-sizing: border-box.
- [border-radius($args...)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/border-radius/): Rounds corners, either all of them, one named corner, or all four individually.
- [brand-logo($width, $height, $image-url: null)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/brand-logo/): Logo box with an image and an accessible stretched link over it.
- [breakpoint($params...)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/breakpoint/): Media query built from the breakpoint map, or from raw lengths.
- [breakpointer($selector: null)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/breakpointer/): Debug helper that prints the active breakpoint name into a pseudo-element.
- [center($axis: "both")](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/center/): Centres an absolutely positioned element in its positioned parent, leaving transform free.
- [circle($size)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/circle/): Square element with a fully rounded border, i.e.
- [columnizer($params...)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/columnizer/): Flexbox grid of equal columns, with an optional gutter written as gap and an optional fill for the last row.
- [container-query($params...)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/container-query/): A @container rule, taking the same argument shapes as breakpoint so the two read alike.
- [container($name: null, $type: inline-size)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/container/): Marks an element as a query container, so container-query can ask about its width instead of the viewport's.
- [counter($params...)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/counter/): Numbers the children of the element it is included in, with optional text before and after each number.
- [ellipsis($width: 100%, $display: inline-block)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/ellipsis/): Truncates a single line of text with an ellipsis.
- [escape-to-parent($selector: null)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/escape-to-parent/): Writes the rule again with another selector attached to its outermost element, so a theme or state class can switch what a nested rule does.
- [except($params...)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/except/): Selects every sibling except the ones named.
- [focus-ring($width: 2px, $offset: 2px, $color: currentColor)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/focus-ring/): Draws a keyboard focus ring with outline on :focus-visible, which survives forced-colors mode where a box-shadow ring disappears.
- [font-face($font-family, $file-path, $font-style: normal, $font-weight: 400, $file-formats: woff2, $font-display: null)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/font-face/): Emits an @font-face rule for one family across several file formats.
- [gradient($colors, $type: linear, $direction: null, $shape: null, $position: null, $from: null, $in: null, $repeating: false)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/gradient/): A linear, radial or conic gradient as background-image, plain or repeating, with an optional colour interpolation space.
- [hide($toggle: "hide")](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/hide/): Visually hides an element while keeping it available to screen readers, either always or until it or anything inside it has keyboard focus.
- [line-clamp($lines: 3)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/line-clamp/): Truncates text after a number of lines, where ellipsis truncates one.
- [loadify($params...)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/loadify/): Fades elements in on page load.
- [motion-safe](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/motion-safe/): Wraps its content in @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference), so motion is opt-in: a user who asked their system for less motion gets none of it.
- [only($params...)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/only/): Selects only the siblings named.
- [placeholder-shown](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/placeholder-shown/): Styles an input while its placeholder is visible, which is how a floating label knows the field is empty.
- [placeholder](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/placeholder/): Styles the placeholder text of an input or a textarea.
- [position($position: absolute, $offsets: 0, $logical: false)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/position/): Sets position and offsets in one call, using shorthand order.
- [remove($params...)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/remove/): Hides an element outright, or within a media query: from a breakpoint up with min, up to it with max, or between two breakpoints.
- [reset-css](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/reset-css/): Meyer reset.
- [reset-figure](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/reset-figure/): Drops a figure's default margins and fits the image inside it.
- [resizable($direction: both, $overflow: auto)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/resizable/): Makes an element user-resizable.
- [responsive-image](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/responsive-image/): Fits an image to its container without upscaling it or losing its proportions.
- [scissors($corners)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/scissors/): Cuts the corners off an element with clip-path.
- [screen-agent($resolution)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/screen-agent/): Media query targeting a screen pixel density.
- [sizer($width, $height: $width)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/sizer/): Sets width and height together; one argument makes a square.
- [smartphone($device, $orientation: null)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/smartphone/): Media query for one phone's screen, by name, from $map-for-smartphones.
- [sprite($params...)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/sprite/): Sets up an element as a sprite tile: an image, a background position, or both.
- [stretched-link($value: "before")](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/stretched-link/): Spreads a link over its positioned parent, so the whole card is clickable.
- [tablet($device, $orientation: null)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/tablet/): Media query for one tablet's screen, by name, from $map-for-tablets.
- [text-gradient($colors, $type: linear, $direction: null, $shape: null, $position: null, $from: null, $in: null, $repeating: false)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/text-gradient/): Fills the text with a gradient through background-clip: text.
- [text-image($image: null, $fallback: null)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/text-image/): Fills the letters with an image, with a colour to fall back to.
- [text-selection($value: null)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/text-selection/): Styles the ::selection pseudo-element.
- [text-shadow($params...)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/text-shadow/): Layered text shadows, each written as a direction or an angle, a colour and a distance.
- [text-stroke($width: 1px, $color: currentColor, $style: hollow, $fill: null)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/text-stroke/): An outline on text, in three looks: outside the letter, straddling it, or the letter left unfilled.
- [tokens($map, $prefix: null)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/tokens/): Writes a Sass map out as CSS custom properties, for any kind of token: colours, spacing, sizes, radii, type, shadows, durations.
- [triangle($direction: "bottom", $color: black, $size: 10px 8px)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/triangle/): Draws a CSS triangle out of borders, pointing in a given direction.

## Functions

- [clearUnit($value)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/clear-unit/): Strips the unit off a number, returning it unitless.
- [clearWhitespace($string)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/clear-whitespace/): Removes every space from a string.
- [convertToEm($value)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/convert-to-em/): Converts a pixel length to em, against a 16px base.
- [convertToNumber($value)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/convert-to-number/): Parses a string of digits into a number.
- [fillNulls($value, $seperation: comma, $skip: false)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/fill-nulls/): Replaces null entries in a list with 0, or drops them.
- [fluid($min, $max, $min-viewport: 320px, $max-viewport: 1280px)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/fluid/): A clamp() value that grows with the viewport between two widths, then stops.
- [fontSizer($size, $time)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/font-sizer/): Multiplies a size by a factor.
- [fontSource($font-family, $file-path, $file-formats)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/font-source/): Builds one src entry for an @font-face rule.
- [gradientValue($colors, $type: linear, $direction: null, $shape: null, $position: null, $from: null, $in: null, $repeating: false)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/gradient-value/): The gradient mixin's gradient as a value, for layering it with an image in one background-image, or using it as a mask-image or border-image.
- [isColor($value)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/is-color/): Returns the value if every item in it is a colour, and errors otherwise.
- [isGutter($value)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/is-gutter/): True for anything that can sit where a CSS length is expected: a number, a calculation, or a CSS function such as var().
- [isNumber($value)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/is-number/): Returns the value when it is a number, and raises when it is not.
- [isTime($value)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/is-time/): Returns the value if it is a time in s or ms, and errors otherwise.
- [mapDeepGet($map, $keys...)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/map-deep-get/): Reads a value out of a nested map by following a chain of keys.
- [pixelify($value)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/pixelify/): Returns the value in pixels: a unitless number takes a px, and a length in another unit is converted.
- [pseudoSelector($elements, $pseudo: null)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/pseudo-selector/): Appends a pseudo-class to every selector in a list.
- [remify($value)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/remify/): Converts a pixel length to rem, against a 16px root.
- [shade($color, $percentage)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/shade/): Mixes a colour towards black by a percentage.
- [shorthandProperty($value)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/shorthand-property/): Expands one to four values into the four-value CSS shorthand order.
- [tint($color, $percentage)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/tint/): Mixes a colour towards white by a percentage.
- [validateBreakpoint($value)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/validate-breakpoint/): Resolves a breakpoint name to its width, passing a length, a percentage or a CSS function through, and refusing a word that is not a key.
- [validateLength($value)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/validate-length/): Returns the value if it is a length or one of auto, inherit, initial, 0.
- [validateRatio($ratio)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/validate-ratio/): Turns an aspect ratio into a value for the CSS aspect-ratio property.
- [validateScissors($value)](https://docs.gerillass.com/docs/validate-scissors/): Normalises corner values for the scissors mixin, adding px where missing.

## Optional

- [gerillass.json](https://github.com/selfishprimate/gerillass/blob/main/gerillass.json): the full machine-readable API. Every member with its signature, what each argument accepts, examples that compile, and the inputs it refuses. Ships inside the installed package at `node_modules/gerillass/gerillass.json`, and at the root of the gem, whose folder `bundle info gerillass --path` prints.
- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/selfishprimate/gerillass/blob/main/SKILL.md): the same material written as an agent skill, generated from the manifest. Ships in the npm package and in the gem.
- [README](https://github.com/selfishprimate/gerillass/blob/main/README.md): installation for Vite, webpack, Next.js, Angular, Gulp, Grunt, Rails and Jekyll, and how to point an agent at the two files above.
- [MIGRATION.md](https://github.com/selfishprimate/gerillass/blob/main/MIGRATION.md): upgrading a project to 3.0.0, where the gradient mixins changed, and from 1.x to 2.0.0, where the utility functions were renamed and two mixins were replaced.
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/selfishprimate/gerillass/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): what changed in every release.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/selfishprimate/gerillass): the `.scss` sources, which are short and readable.
